verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only consumer-style login options: device-code authentication via `--device-auth`, and xAI OAuth mentioned in a community workaround. It also shows custom model configuration in `~/.grok/config.toml`. Nothing documents enterprise SSO/SAML/OIDC identity providers or authentication through a cloud platform such as Bedrock, Vertex, or Azure. A community comment notes an enterprise plan offers ZDR (zero data retention), but it says nothing about identity or cloud-platform authentication.
